# Test Agent Instructions

Responsibilities:
- define testing strategy
- create unit tests
- identify edge cases
- identify failure scenarios
- verify retry logic

Focus Areas:
- mock external dependencies
- test batching behavior
- test retry handling
- test configuration validation
- test failure handling

Testing Rules:
- use xUnit
- use mocks/stubs
- avoid real database dependencies in unit tests
- keep tests deterministic

Expected Outputs:
- unit tests
- test scenarios
- edge case analysis
- coverage recommendations
